comment:
* LayoutParams used by StaggeredGridLayoutManager. *

* Note that if the orientation is {@link #VERTICAL}, the width parameter is ignored and if the * orientation is {@link #HORIZONTAL} the height parameter is ignored because child view is * expected to fill all of the space given to it.

variables.name: INVALID_SPAN_ID
variables.comment: * Span Id for Views that are not laid out yet.

variables.name: mSpan
variables.comment: Package scope to be able to access from tests.

methods.name: public void setFullSpan(boolean fullSpan)
methods.comment:
* When set to true, the item will layout using all span area. That means, if orientation
         * is vertical, the view will have full width; if orientation is horizontal, the view will
         * have full height.
         *
         * @param fullSpan True if this item should traverse all spans.
         * @see #isFullSpan()

methods.name: public boolean isFullSpan()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether this View occupies all available spans or just one.
         *
         * @return True if the View occupies all spans or false otherwise.
         * @see #setFullSpan(boolean)

methods.name: public final int getSpanIndex()
methods.comment:
* Returns the Span index to which this View is assigned.
         *
         * @return The Span index of the View. If View is not yet assigned to any span, returns
         * {@link #INVALID_SPAN_ID}.
